content.title: 2018 ACHD Guideline
content.focus: Clinical studies and guidelines related to the management of Tetralogy of Fallot and associated surgical interventions, specifically discussing implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, catheter-based procedures, and valve replacement surgeries.
key_areas: Implantable cardioverter-defibrillators in tetralogy of Fallot.
Long-term outcomes and ventricular function post-surgery.
Right ventricular function and predictors of arrhythmia.
Risk factors for atrial and ventricular tachyarrhythmias.
